thread:
Maya: @eng-ml incoming customer request to onboard Ember-20B for a doc-summarization endpoint. Customer expects ~200ms p95 on short docs, wants deterministic outputs, EU region.
Samir: what are the typical input lengths (tokens)?
Maya: mostly 200-800 tokens, occasional up to 2k. Target throughput ~50 req/s sustained.
Liam: quick checklist for bring-up: 1) confirm model artifacts (hf/ggml/onnx) 2) baseline fp16 perf + memory 3) PTQ (8-bit) smoke, check quality 4) run customer prompt evals + our regression tests 5) prepare rollout + fallback.
Olga: priority = medium-high. Customer on trial but EU compliance matters. Recommend small Dedicated pool and canary rollout. @Samir can you own the quant experiments?
Samir: yes. plan: run FP16 smoke first, then GPTQ-style PTQ. If activations go bad we'll try layerwise scale or bias correction. ETA 48-72h for initial results.
benchy-bot: note — nearest comparable is raptor-12b on a4g: int8 PTQ results p50=70ms, p95=230ms (batch=1, seq=512). link: https://bench.redwood/raptor-12b
Maya: added customer prompt set: https://gist.github.com/example (contains 120 prompts, edge cases flagged). Also they need sampling disabled (deterministic top-k).
Samir: smoke commands I'll run:
```
# fp16 baseline
python run_inference.py --model /mnt/models/ember-20b --dtype float16 --batch 1 --max_tokens 1024

# PTQ (calib set = customer prompts)
quantize --model ember-20b --method gptq --bits 8 --calibrate data/calib.json --out ember-20b-int8
```
Samir: will post perf + accuracy delta vs fp16 in thread when done.
Liam: ops reminder: update model-catalog entry with tags (ember-20b, eu, quant-ready) and add rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
Olga: scheduling canary for next Tue 10:00 UTC. If quantized model regresses beyond threshold, fallback to fp16 hosted. Also loop in Security for EU data flow check.
Maya: thanks — assigning follow-ups: Samir=quant experiments, Liam=catalog & rollout, Olga=orchestration + canary schedule. Ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
